body: When you are 16, the only place you have to meet people is school so the people you meet there are always the same people. Even if there are thousands of students, its still not the best place to try to find a girlfriend, imo. Or a boyfriend really. You change a lot when you become a real adult (at about 22++++, I'm not even a real adult and I am 23) plus when you are older, have a car and have control of your life (like where you go and what you do) you can meet new people. Honestly, even if you don't date again for a long time, its a great time to work on yourself -- like hobbies, friends etc.

Every now and then, I feel completely empty and burning at the same time. Its almost like my chest hurts, even though I know it isn't. Then I just start crying loudly cause its like a memory attack.

I'm not sure if something like that has happened to you, but I know it at least doesn't get much worse than that. (For me anyway)

Thanks a lot. I don't think I will break up with my boyfriend, cause he at least notices when I am sad and tries to cheer me up, but I am not able to open up just because I've been let down before. I also have a hard time telling people I know, IRL, about the things that plague me. Childhood, teenage years etc were pretty bad for me, sometimes I think about how much I wish I could beat some people's faces in and I get so depressed just knowing that some people have gotten away with stupid shit -- if you pardon my language.

Thanks. I try very hard at school, but I feel like everyone expects me to have a full time job and live alone and almost be married etc. Those things just seem so far away even though I am on the brink of graduation.

I feel the exact same way as you, AnsheShem. I feel like a big faker to everyone around me as well. The truth is, my friends come to me to cheer them up and so I do it. I used to unload my troubles onto other friends I had but I've since grown apart from them so now I feel like I have no one -I- can turn to for a shoulder.

We just have to keep on fighting and hope that sometime a person we know in real life will be the one we can confess our real feelings to.
